method: Joint prompt-cluster bootstrap. One resample of prompt indices per replicate is applied to both arms and every rule, so it respects both the prompt pairing between the watermarked and unwatermarked arms and the correlation between rules scored on the same documents. DeLong's analytic variance handles only the second.
prompt_note: documents 0-499 continue the released prompts and also informed the tail-width family; prompt_start=500 excludes them
multiplicity: Holm step-down over all reported contrasts and cells.
